items.h: Product Type: IP Phone (VoIP Desk Phone)
Audio: HD Voice, Full Duplex Speakerphone
Power Supply: Adapter Included (PoE supported in some setups)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GXP1610P Basic HD IP Phone with Adapter is a reliable and cost-effective VoIP communication solution designed for small businesses, offices, and professional users. It delivers clear HD voice quality and stable SIP-based communication for everyday business calling needs.


With support for multiple call features, dual 10/100 Mbps network ports, and PoE capability (model dependent), the GXP1610P ensures smooth and efficient communication. Its compact design, user-friendly interface, and high compatibility with IP PBX systems make it an ideal choice for modern office environments.


This IP phone is built for durability, easy deployment, and secure communication, making it a trusted solution for business telephony needs at an affordable price.


Key Features

  • HD Voice Quality for Clear Communication
  • Supports SIP-based VoIP Calling
  • 2-Line Operation with Multiple Call Handling
  • 10/100 Mbps Dual Switched Ethernet Ports
  • 3 XML Programmable Context-Sensitive Soft Keys
  • 132 × 48 LCD Display for Easy Viewing
  • 3-Way Audio Conferencing Support
  • Advanced Call Features (Hold, Transfer, Forward)
  • EHS Support for Headset Integration
  • Secure Communication with Encryption Support
  • Easy Installation and Configuration
  • Power Adapter Included for Convenience
  • Suitable for Office, Call Center & Business Use
